item.title: Daily Minute — November 12, 2026
item.description:
Only refusal to accept yourself could make the question seem to be sincere. The only thing that can be surely known by any living thing is what it is. From this one point of certainty it looks on other things as certain as itself. Uncertainty about what you must be is self-deception on a scale so vast its magnitude can hardly be conceived.

item.title: Lesson 133: “I will not value what is valueless.”
